targets.authors: Dobbs, S., Furnham, A., & McClelland, A.
targets.title: The effect of background music and noise on the cognitive test performance of introverts and extraverts.
targets.evidence_quote: The present study is a part replication of the Dobbs et al. (2011) study but using Chinese participants.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, the present experiment aimed to replicate the findings from Dobbs et al. (2011) who showed that performance on cognitive tasks was adversely affected by background sounds, and that this effect was moderated by the extraversion personality variable. The result suggests that unlike the findings in Western individuals, Chinese people are not distracted by music and noise and there is no interaction with personality.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The conclusion contrasts the absence of both distraction and personality interaction with the target findings.

reasoning: A new Chinese sample re-tests Dobbs et al. (2011). Other studies discussed in the introduction provide background, not additional explicitly re-tested targets. The institutional accepted manuscript has small title and author-spelling differences and sample discrepancies versus the final abstract, but the repository DOI, authors, topic and study identity match.
